answer: Referred to VINM, the input noise density is 425 nV/√Hz at 1 kHz and 29.2 nV/√Hz at 1 MHz (noise analysis on ngspice with the PDK's typical models at 27 C). At 1 kHz flicker noise dominates: the density is 4.2 uV/√Hz at 10 Hz and falls tenfold over the two decades to 1 kHz, as 1/f noise does. By 1 MHz it has reached the thermal floor of the input pair and the mirror load.
